incident.title: Update downloads failing from one mirror
incident.markdown:
## Impact

For about 50 minutes, roughly a quarter of update and installer downloads failed with a checksum error and were retried. No corrupted build was ever installed: the editor checks every download before it applies it.

## Timeline

1. 18:05 UTC — a mirror starts serving a truncated file
2. 18:21 UTC — the checksum-failure alert fires
3. 18:38 UTC — the mirror is removed from rotation
4. 18:55 UTC — the failure rate is back to zero

## What caused it

A disk on one mirror filled up during a sync, so it served a partial copy of the newest release.

## What we changed

Mirrors now verify each release against its checksum before they start serving it, and leave rotation by themselves when they cannot.

updates.body: Some update downloads are failing with a checksum error. The editor retries them automatically. We are investigating.
